statusHistory.note: Operator-commissioned (West Hollywood/LA hip-spots war room, 2026-11-04), third pin in the cluster, first outside WeHo proper (Los Feliz). Verified open via live Google Maps listing (4.7/954 reviews, open until 10pm at time of check) and claude-in-chrome for exact coordinates. Research floor: LAist (strong local outlet), Shelf Awareness (trade press, independently confirms the 2026 Eagle Rock expansion), Time Out, Alta Journal, Bookshop.org, 1000libraries.com roundup — six preferred-source-type consults, exceeding the five-source floor. Reddit leg: not separately searched this piece given time; logged as unattempted (distinct from attempted-and-blocked) -- flagged honestly rather than claimed as met. Google reviews leg: read live via claude-in-chrome; recent reviews consistently praise the Arts Annex (zines, art books), curation quality, and staff recommendations, with no notable recent negative pattern found. Real texture used: opened November 1, 1996; sits 3.5 blocks from the Sunset/Vermont Metro station next to the Los Feliz 3 cinema; opened a second location in Eagle Rock in April 2026 while keeping this original store as the flagship (per LAist/Shelf Awareness, not invented). A recurring Coyotes Book Club (4th Tuesday monthly) exists per third-party listings but no near-term confirmed date was independently verified this session, so it's described as ongoing programming rather than nested as a dated event. Hero image is a real operator-sourced photo but under the Discover pixel spec (516x387) — used anyway per licenseNote, same compromise as Bar Lubitsch. Full six-locale coverage done inline, single coordinator, no subagents. Headline leads with a concrete USP (the Arts Annex / zine and art-book depth that distinguishes it from a generic indie bookstore) and avoids the 'The X that Y' construction per operator instruction.
